kitEvidence.formula:
Twisted Fate begins shuffling his deck, allowing him to Recast to lock in one of three cards and enhance his next Attack.
The Blue Card deals [40 / 60 / 80 / 100 / 120 + (1) × AD + (1) × AP + ((0.575) × ((40 / 60 / 80 / 100 / 120 + (1) × AD + (1) × AP))) × Stat(8)] magic damage and restores [70 / 90 / 110 / 130 / 150] Mana.The Red Card deals [30 / 45 / 60 / 75 / 90 + (1) × AD + (0.7) × AP + ((0.35) × ((30 / 45 / 60 / 75 / 90 + (1) × AD + (0.7) × AP))) × Stat(8)] to nearby enemies and Slows by [30 / 35 / 40 / 45 / 50]% for 2.5 seconds.The Gold Card deals [15 / 22.5 / 30 / 37.5 / 45 + (1) × AD + (0.5) × AP + ((0.25) × ((15 / 22.5 / 30 / 37.5 / 45 + (1) × AD + (0.5) × AP))) × Stat(8)] and Stuns for [1 / 1.25 / 1.5 / 1.75 / 2] seconds.
